basic_info.description: Experience modern urban living in this stylish 1-bedroom, 2-bath loft, set within a boutique building in vibrant SOMA. Boasting an expansive open-concept floor plan, this home features upgraded flooring, remodeled kitchen, and a full bath on the main level. The second floor offers a spacious bedroom with an en-suite bath, while a versatile mezzanine provides the perfect space for a home office, creative studio, or exercise area. Enjoy the luxury of a private terrace with city views, soaring floor-to-ceiling windows that flood the space with natural light, and the convenience of an in-unit washer/dryer. This home also includes one dedicated parking space, extra storage, and access to a shared rooftop deck. Scores: Walk = 98; Transit = 100; Bike = 99. Conveniently located just minutes from Sightglass Coffee, Rainbow Foods, and a two-minute walk to Costco, this loft offers unparalleled access to freeways, bike routes, and public transit.
